entities.name: otel-demo/Namespace/otel-demo
entities.reasoning: Namespace shows sustained CPU throttling alerts across multiple deployments, indicating a resource pressure root cause.
entities.evidence: CPUThrottlingHigh alerts firing for otel-demo namespace; RequestErrorRate alerts also firing for same namespace.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/cart
entities.reasoning: Cart pods exhibit high CPU throttling leading to request errors, driving the RequestErrorRate alert.
entities.evidence: CPUThrottlingHigh alert active; RequestErrorRate alert spikes coinciding with cart pod metric timestamps.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/frontend
entities.reasoning: Frontend receives error responses from downstream cart service, causing its own degraded performance.
entities.evidence: RequestErrorRate alert includes frontend request errors after cart throttling period.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/checkout
entities.reasoning: Checkout depends on cart and experiences increased latency due to cart throttling.
entities.evidence: Trace analysis shows checkout spans waiting on cart service during throttling window.
